titulo: Your first battle as a Roman legionary 🛡️ Part 3 #history #shorts
descripcion:
Throw the pilum, close the shield wall, stab with the short sword. Survive twenty-five years, and Augustus pays you about thirteen years of salary.

Sources: Cassius Dio 55.23; Res Gestae of Augustus.

Would you have lasted 25 years?

#history #ancientrome #romanlegion #historyfacts #shorts

lineas.texto: The enemy is coming, and you stand in a line, shield to shield.
At thirty paces, you throw your pilum, a heavy javelin.
It bends on impact, so nobody can throw it back.
Then, shields up. Under arrows, you lock into the tortoise.
You fight with a short sword, stabbing, not swinging.
Every few minutes, the front line rotates, so fresh men fight.
Survive twenty-five years, and Rome pays you a bonus.
About thirteen years of salary, in one go. Would you have lasted?
